name: productivity
description: Portable, general-purpose productivity skills for any workflow: hand the conversation off to a new agent (handoff), get a plan stress-tested through relentless interview (grill-me), stand up a monitor outside the chat (watch), explain one thing in plain language with no decisions attached (explain), turn the agent's own pile of findings and jargon into small plain-language decisions walked one at a time (untangle), and author a new skill that is portable, concise, in a generic voice, with a trigger-rich description (write-a-skill).
